svg.title: LinkedIn Agent — Agentic AI System Engineering

g.title: LinkedIn Agent — Agentic AI System Engineering
g.desc: The installed private LinkedIn workflow coordinates ChatGPT, LinkedIn vacancy research, GitHub project evidence, Gmail history and outreach, Google Drive CV storage, and canonical Atlas records in Google Sheets. Verified receipts converge in Atlas; Atlas alone delivers the approved dashboard projection. Blue packet animation illustrates the architecture, not live activity.
g.text: One workflow. Connected evidence. Verified outcomes.
Stage → native write → exact readback → commit
Stable identities · exact artifacts · provider receipts · recoverable checkpoints
